mechanism: Tenofovir can reduce renal function and increase sacubitril/valsartan exposure, while sacubitril may potentiate tenofovir nephrotoxicity through additive effects on glomerular filtration.
action: Monitor renal function (eGFR, creatinine) regularly; assess blood pressure control; consider dose adjustments if renal decline occurs; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for hyperkalemia.
